messages.text: Hi! I'm the virtual assistant. What can I help you with today?
My campaign emails are all landing in spam since yesterday. I'm sending from sarah@brightpathcoaching.com to about 3,000 contacts.
Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out! Please keep this window open. Could you tell me which sub-account this is for?
It's the Bright Path Coaching sub-account. I set up a dedicated domain last week, mail.brightpathcoaching.com. You can call me on +1 (415) 555-0132 if easier.
